title: Inverse cosine values and a sum rewritten as a single sine term
intro: No calculator. Give exact values, use radians, and show the work for each part. Only real solutions are asked for.

parts.label: A(i)
parts.prompt: Find the exact value of sin⁡(cos−1⁡(−35))\sin\left(\cos^{-1}\left(-\frac{3}{5}\right)\right).

rubric.point: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>4</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{4}{5}</annotation></semantics></math>, positive because <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>cos</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos^{-1}\left(-\frac{3}{5}\right)</annotation></semantics></math> is in <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>,</mo><mi>π</mi></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right)</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.sample: Let <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>θ</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>cos</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\theta = \cos^{-1}\left(-\frac{3}{5}\right)</annotation></semantics></math>, an angle in <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>π</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">[0, \pi]</annotation></semantics></math> with <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos\theta = -\frac{3}{5}</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>θ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\theta</annotation></semantics></math> is in Quadrant II. <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>sin</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin^2\theta</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>9</mn><mn>25</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 1 - \frac{9}{25}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mfrac><mn>16</mn><mn>25</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \frac{16}{25}</annotation></semantics></math>, and sine is positive in Quadrant II, so <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>4</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin\theta = \frac{4}{5}</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: A(ii)
parts.prompt: Solve cos−1⁡(x)=5π6\cos^{-1}(x) = \frac{5\pi}{6} for xx.
parts.sample: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>5</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{5\pi}{6}</annotation></semantics></math> is in <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>π</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">[0, \pi]</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>5</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><mn>6</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = \cos\frac{5\pi}{6} = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: B
parts.prompt: Rewrite k(x)k(x)=sin⁡(x+π6)= \sin\left(x + \frac{\pi}{6}\right)+sin⁡(x−π6)+ \sin\left(x - \frac{\pi}{6}\right) as a single term of the form asin⁡xa\sin x. Show the identities you use.

rubric.point: Expands both with the sum and difference identities for sine
accept: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin x\cos\frac{\pi}{6}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">+</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+ \cos x\sin\frac{\pi}{6}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">+</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+ \sin x\cos\frac{\pi}{6} - \cos x\sin\frac{\pi}{6}</annotation></semantics></math>

<math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mfrac><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\sin x</annotation></semantics></math> simplified to <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sqrt{3}\sin x</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.sample: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin\left(x + \frac{\pi}{6}\right)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \sin x\cos\frac{\pi}{6}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">+</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+ \cos x\sin\frac{\pi}{6}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin\left(x - \frac{\pi}{6}\right)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \sin x\cos\frac{\pi}{6} - \cos x\sin\frac{\pi}{6}</annotation></semantics></math>. Adding, the cosine terms cancel: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k(x)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 2\sin x\cos\frac{\pi}{6}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mfrac><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 2\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\sin x</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \sqrt{3}\sin x</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: C

rubric.point: Uses part B to get <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin x = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}</annotation></semantics></math> and gives one correct solution
accept: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sqrt{3}\sin x = \frac{3}{2}</annotation></semantics></math> so <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin x = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}</annotation></semantics></math>

rubric.point: Both solutions <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = \frac{\pi}{3}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = \frac{2\pi}{3}</annotation></semantics></math>, and no others

parts.sample: By part B, <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sqrt{3}\sin x = \frac{3}{2}</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mrow><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin x = \frac{3}{2\sqrt{3}} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}</annotation></semantics></math>. In <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">[0, 2\pi)</annotation></semantics></math> this gives <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = \frac{\pi}{3}</annotation></semantics></math> and, by symmetry, <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>π</mi><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = \pi - \frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{2\pi}{3}</annotation></semantics></math>.
